python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

# OCR the invoice image
img = Image.open("/workspace/testbed/images/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img).strip()
print("=== OCR Output ===")
print(text)
print("==================")

# Parse the extracted fields
fields = {}
for line in text.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.lower().startswith("invoice"):
        fields["Invoice Number"] = line.split("#")[-1].strip() if "#" in line else line
    elif line.lower().startswith("date"):
        fields["Date"] = line.split(":", 1)[-1].strip()
    elif line.lower().startswith("total"):
        fields["Total"] = line.split(":", 1)[-1].strip()

# Create Excel workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice Data"

# Header row (bold)
headers = ["Field", "Value"]
for col, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=h)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)

# Data rows
for row, (field, value) in enumerate(fields.items(), 2):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=field)
    ws.cell(row=row, column=2, value=value)

# Also include the raw OCR text in a second sheet
ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Raw OCR Text")
ws2.cell(row=1, column=1, value="Raw OCR Output").font = Font(bold=True)
for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 2):
    ws2.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

# Auto-size columns (approximate)
for sheet in [ws, ws2]:
    for col in sheet.columns:
        max_len = max((len(str(cell.value or "")) for cell in col), default=0)
        sheet.column_dimensions[col[0].column_letter].width = max_len + 4

output_path = "/workspace/invoice_data.xlsx"
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\nExcel file saved to: {output_path}")
PYEOF
